subject: design/feature-draft-approval
statement: Read the operator approval through a port that requires the pull request current head and the approving review commit to equal the requested lock head; preserve the review body as the capture line and scope code ownership to contract and abandonment records.
intent: Prevent an agent review or an older-head review from authorizing a draft lock while preserving the existing merge policy for proposals outside the owned paths.
rationale: The GitHub adapter reads the pull head before and after paginated reviews; the shared selector accepts the operator latest submitted approval only. The local adapter reads the same review shape from closed fixtures. CODEOWNERS targets PRD records, design Documents, and abandonment Learnings.
fit_criterion: Operator review of head H returns identity and capture line or lineless; stale, dismissed, agent, or moved-head reviews return no approval; local and GitHub adapters pass fixture tests; code-owner review settings are inspected on main after the operator applies them.
